en.headline: Yu Lan Cultural Festival ends today at Victoria Park
en.dek: The three-day event marking the Hungry Ghost Festival closes Sunday with competitions, workshops, an immersive theatre piece and Chiu Chow food stalls; admission is free.
body: The Yu Lan Cultural Festival 2026 holds its final day today at Soccer Pitch 1 in Victoria Park, Causeway Bay, running from 10am to 9pm. Organised by the Federation of Hong Kong Chiu Chow Community Organizations Charity Funds with support from the Tourism Commission and Hong Kong Tourism Board, the free event marks the Hungry Ghost Festival observed in the seventh lunar month.

Highlights include the Piu Kiu competition, which this year drew more than 70 teams and over 400 participants from Hong Kong, the Greater Bay Area, Korea, Malaysia and Myanmar, as well as paper-crafting and Chiu Chow kung-fu tea workshops, cultural exhibitions and guided tours. An immersive interactive theatre piece titled Cross Beyond explores the history of Chiu Chow migration to Hong Kong and is staged in the evenings.

Visitors can also browse festival offerings, try traditional snacks at food stalls and take part in the Merit+1 checkpoint challenge. The organisers said the programme aims to pass on intangible cultural heritage to younger generations through a mix of traditional rites and contemporary formats. The festival is funded under the Leisure and Cultural Services Department’s Intangible Cultural Heritage Funding Scheme.

zh.headline: 盂蘭文化節今日維園煞科 搶孤及互動劇場繼續
zh.dek: 一連三日的盂蘭文化節今日於銅鑼灣維多利亞公園一號球場舉行最後一天，設搶孤競賽、工作坊、實境劇場及潮汕美食攤位，免費入場。
body: 2026盂蘭文化節今日（9月6日）於銅鑼灣維多利亞公園一號球場舉行最後一天活動，時間為上午10時至晚上9時。活動由香港潮屬社團總會慈善基金主辦，獲旅遊事務署及香港旅遊發展局支持，紀念農曆七月盂蘭節傳統。
今年搶孤競賽規模創歷來新高，吸引本地、大灣區、韓國、馬來西亞及緬甸等地逾70隊、超過400人參賽。現場亦設紮作摺紙、潮汕工夫茶等工作坊、文化展覽、導賞，以及實境互動劇場《渡海·渡人》，晚間演出探討潮人渡海來港的歷史。
市民可品嚐潮汕美食、參與「功德+1」打卡活動，以及體驗盆供堆疊等項目。主辦方表示，活動以傳統與創新並重的形式，向年輕一代傳承非物質文化遺產。活動獲康樂及文化事務署非物質文化遺產資助計劃資助。
